verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents read-only Shares granted to specific users or preset roles, including tenant isolation and an Explorer role for org-wide sharing. Shares can be limited to particular tables and views with an include pattern, which gives coarse role-based, table-level access control. Missing for 10: column-level permissions, row-level security policies, data masking policies, fine-grained write/privilege grants beyond read-only shares, and independent corroboration.
